title: Surjective derived Hom comparison by effacement
statement: Let C and D be abelian categories with derived categories and Ext, with enough injectives in C. Let F:C→D be an additive exact functor, L∈C, B∈D and a:B→F(L). Assume every map B→F(N) is a∘F(f) for some f:L→N, and Ext^(n+1)(B,F(I))=0 for every injective I of C and n≥0. For every N and n≥0 the induced map Hom_D+(C)(L[0],N[0][n])→Hom_D+(D)(B[0],F(N)[0][n]), given explicitly by a and the single/shift comparisons, is surjective.

source.place: Tag 03FD, acyclic-resolution proof, expressed by the universal delta-functor/effacement argument

proof.text: In degree zero identify Ext⁰ with ordinary Hom; the assumed degree-zero surjectivity gives a preimage. Mathlib Ext.homEquiv₀ and mapExactFunctor_mk₀ identify the explicit comparison.

For degree n+1 choose an injective presentation N→I and its cokernel K. Exactness of F preserves the short exact sequence. Since Ext^(n+1)(B,F(I)) is zero, the connecting map Ext^n(B,F(K))→Ext^(n+1)(B,F(N)) is surjective (Mathlib Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁). Lift its preimage by induction to Ext^n(L,K). Compose with the short exact sequence Ext class. Compatibility of mapExactFunctor with composition and extClass proves that the resulting class has the required image.

Convert Ext classes to morphisms in the bounded-below derived category using the fully faithful inclusion into the full derived category. The comparison of single functors and the inclusion shift isomorphism identifies the Ext comparison with the displayed derived comparison. Naturality moves the shift comparisons; their inverse factors cancel.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03FD, acyclic-resolution proof, expressed by the universal delta-functor/effacement argument; Q3 formalizes the acyclic comparison by effacement and Mathlib adjunctions

mathlib_searches.query: Exact functor derived Hom surjective comparison by acyclic images of injectives
An exact functor with surjective Hom comparison and acyclic images of injectives induces surjective Ext comparison for a fixed source
mathlib_searches.results: Found Ext.mapExactFunctor_hom/comp, injective-resolution APIs and Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁; no full comparison criterion.
MapExt bijectivity requires fully faithful functors preserving injectives, unlike scalar forgetting.

theorem derivedHomComparison_surjective
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [EnoughInjectives C]
    [HasDerivedCategory C] [HasExt.{w} C]
    {D : Type u'} [Category.{v'} D] [Abelian D]
    [HasDerivedCategory D] [HasExt.{v'} D] [EnoughInjectives D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (L : C) (B : D) (a : B ⟶ F.obj L)
    (hzero : ∀ N : C, Function.Surjective (fun f : L ⟶ N ↦ a ≫ F.map f))
    (hacyclic : ∀ (I : C) [Injective I],
      (preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (op B)).rightAcyclic (F.obj I)) (N : C) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (fun x :
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor C 0).obj L ⟶
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor C 0).obj N)⟦(n : ℤ)⟧ ↦
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor D 0).map a ≫
        (F.mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).inv.app L ≫
        F.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map x ≫
        (F.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.commShiftIso (n : ℤ)).hom.app
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor C 0).obj N) ≫
        (shiftFunctor _ (n : ℤ)).map
          ((F.mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app N))
